title: HSK 2.3 · 应该, 发现, 感觉, 意思, 刚才
focus: 又 · 问题 · 它 · 该 · 更 · 才 · 像 · 向 · 应该 · 位 · 大家 · 发现 · 一定 · 一直 · 感觉 · 出现 · 见到 · 发 · 接 · 刚 · 接受 · 直接 · 家庭 · 刚刚 · 想到 · 好像 · 愿意 · 感谢 · 感到 · 它们 · 一般 · 做到 · 受到 · 提 · 意思 · 意见 · 提出 · 实现 · 刚才
body:
Feelings, thoughts and timing words. 到 (reach) turns verbs into results (见到, 想到, 做到), 感 and 意 carry feeling and meaning, and 刚 gives "just now".

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 到 | dào | arrive; (result: reach it) | 见到, 想到, 感到, 做到, 受到 |
| 感 | gǎn | feel (咸 + 心 heart) | 感觉, 感谢, 感到 |
| 意 | yì | idea, intention (音 + 心) | 愿意, 意思, 意见 |
| 现 | xiàn | appear (王 + 见) | 发现, 出现, 实现 |
| 一 | yī / yí / yì | one | 一定, 一直, 一般 |
| 接 | jiē | receive (扌 hand) | 接受, 直接 |
| 刚 | gāng | just | 刚刚, 刚才 |
| 直 | zhí | straight | 一直, 直接 |

## Watch out

- 它 (it), 他 (he) and 她 (she) are all tā; only the radical changes.
- 像 xiàng (resemble) has 亻; 象 xiàng (elephant, image) doesn't; 向 xiàng (toward) is different again.
- 又 = again (for something that already happened); 再 = again (in the future).
- 才 cái vs 寸 cùn and the 扌 hand radical.
- 一 is yí before a 4th tone (一定, 一下) and yì before others (一直, 一般).

cards.Example: 你又来了！ nǐ yòu lái le: You're here again!
cards.Notes: Picture of a right hand. Lookalikes: 叉 chā, 义 yì. 又 = again (already happened); 再 = again (future)

cards.Example: 没问题！ méi wèntí: No problem!
cards.Notes: 问 ask (门 + 口) + 题 topic (是 + 页 head) = a topic asked about: question, problem

cards.Example: 它是我的猫。 tā shì wǒ de māo: It's my cat.
cards.Notes: 宀-like top + 匕; originally a picture of a snake. Same sound as 他 and 她

cards.Example: 该你了。 gāi nǐ le: Your turn.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 亥 hài for the sound (as in 孩 hái)

cards.Example: 今天更冷。 jīntiān gèng lěng: Today is even colder.
cards.Notes: 一 + 日 with a long 乂 sweep underneath; learn it as one shape. It's inside 便 biàn

cards.Example: 他十点才来。 tā shí diǎn cái lái: He didn't come until ten.
cards.Notes: Picture of a sprouting plant (also 'talent'). Lookalikes: 寸 cùn and the 扌 hand radical

cards.Example: 你很像你妈妈。 nǐ hěn xiàng nǐ māma: You look like your mom.
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 象 xiàng (elephant) for the sound. Lookalike: 象 has no 亻

cards.Example: 向左走。 xiàng zuǒ zǒu: Turn left.
cards.Notes: A window 口 in a house 冂, with a stroke on top: the side a house faces

cards.Example: 你应该休息。 nǐ yīnggāi xiūxi: You should rest.
cards.Notes: 应 should (广 + 䒑 + 一) + 该 ought = should. 应 is yīng here (yìng = respond)

cards.Example: 那位老师很好。 nà wèi lǎoshī hěn hǎo: That teacher is great.
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 立 stand = where a person stands: position, seat

cards.Example: 大家好！ dàjiā hǎo: Hi everyone!
cards.Notes: 大 big + 家 family = the whole big family: everybody

cards.Example: 我发现他不在。 wǒ fāxiàn tā bú zài: I noticed he wasn't there.
cards.Notes: 发 send out + 现 appear (王 + 见 see) = bring to light: discover

cards.Example: 我一定来。 wǒ yídìng lái: I'll definitely come.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 定 fix, settle (宀 roof) = settled once and for all. 一 is yí before a 4th tone

cards.Example: 一直往前走。 yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu: Go straight ahead.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 直 straight = straight all the way: continuously

cards.Example: 我感觉好多了。 wǒ gǎnjué hǎo duō le: I feel much better.
cards.Notes: 感 feel (咸 + 心 heart) + 觉 sense (contains 见) = feeling

cards.Example: 问题出现了。 wèntí chūxiàn le: A problem came up.
cards.Notes: 出 come out + 现 appear = emerge

cards.Example: 很高兴见到你。 hěn gāoxìng jiàndào nǐ: Nice to meet you.
cards.Notes: 见 see + 到 reach (result) = get to see

cards.Meaning: to send; to issue; to break out
cards.Example: 我给你发短信。 wǒ gěi nǐ fā duǎnxìn: I'll text you.
cards.Notes: Simplified from both 發 (shoot, send) and 髮 (hair: 头发 tóufa). Lookalike: 友 yǒu

cards.Meaning: to receive; to pick up; to answer (phone)
cards.Example: 我去机场接你。 wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē nǐ: I'll pick you up at the airport.
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 妾 qiè: take with the hand

cards.Example: 我刚到。 wǒ gāng dào: I just got here.
cards.Notes: 冈 gāng for the sound + 刂 knife; first meant hard, strong (刚强)

cards.Example: 我接受你的意见。 wǒ jiēshòu nǐ de yìjiàn: I accept your suggestion.
cards.Notes: 接 receive + 受 accept (爫 hand passing to 又 hand) = take in. 受 vs 爱: 爱 has 友 at the bottom

cards.Example: 你直接去吧。 nǐ zhíjiē qù ba: Just go straight there.
cards.Notes: 直 straight + 接 connect = straight connection: direct

cards.Example: 他的家庭很幸福。 tā de jiātíng hěn xìngfú: His family is happy.
cards.Notes: 家 home + 庭 courtyard (广 + 廷 tíng for the sound) = household

cards.Example: 我刚刚吃完。 wǒ gānggāng chīwán: I just finished eating.
cards.Notes: 刚 just, doubled for emphasis = only just

cards.Example: 我没想到你会来。 wǒ méi xiǎngdào nǐ huì lái: I never expected you to come.
cards.Notes: 想 think + 到 reach = a thought reaches it

cards.Example: 好像要下雨了。 hǎoxiàng yào xiàyǔ le: Looks like rain.
cards.Notes: 好 very + 像 resemble = looks very much like: seems

cards.Example: 你愿意帮我吗？ nǐ yuànyì bāng wǒ ma: Would you be willing to help me?
cards.Notes: 愿 wish (原 + 心 heart) + 意 intention (音 + 心) = the heart's wish: willing

cards.Example: 非常感谢你！ fēicháng gǎnxiè nǐ: Thank you so much!
cards.Notes: 感 feel + 谢 thank = feel thankful. More formal than 谢谢

cards.Example: 我感到很累。 wǒ gǎndào hěn lèi: I feel very tired.
cards.Notes: 感 feel + 到 reach = come to feel

cards.Example: 它们是我的猫。 tāmen shì wǒ de māo: They're my cats.
cards.Notes: 它 it + 们 (plural)

cards.Example: 我一般七点起床。 wǒ yìbān qī diǎn qǐchuáng: I usually get up at seven.
cards.Notes: 一 one + 般 kind (舟 boat + 殳) = one kind: ordinary, usual

cards.Example: 我一定能做到。 wǒ yídìng néng zuòdào: I can definitely do it.
cards.Notes: 做 do + 到 reach = do it successfully

cards.Example: 他受到了表扬。 tā shòudàole biǎoyáng: He was praised.
cards.Notes: 受 receive + 到 reach = receive (praise, help, criticism)

cards.Meaning: to lift; to carry; to mention
cards.Example: 别提了！ bié tí le: Don't bring it up!
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 是 shì for the sound

cards.Example: 这是什么意思？ zhè shì shénme yìsi: What does this mean?
cards.Notes: 意 meaning (音 + 心) + 思 think (田 + 心) = what's in the mind. Both have 心

cards.Example: 你有什么意见？ nǐ yǒu shénme yìjiàn: What do you think?
cards.Notes: 意 idea + 见 view = viewpoint; can also mean a complaint

cards.Example: 他提出了问题。 tā tíchūle wèntí: He raised a question.
cards.Notes: 提 lift + 出 out = bring up, propose

cards.Example: 我的梦想实现了。 wǒ de mèngxiǎng shíxiàn le: My dream came true.
cards.Notes: 实 real (宀 + 头) + 现 appear = make it real

cards.Example: 你刚才去哪儿了？ nǐ gāngcái qù nǎr le: Where were you just now?
cards.Notes: 刚 just + 才 just = a moment ago. 刚才 is a time word; 刚 is an adverb
